title: Graceful Circuit Reset Orchestrator with Sticky State and Controlled Reopen
author: Marta Lopez
description: Motivation: We observed rapid circuit toggles during partial regional outages where independent circuit controllers attempted immediate reopen after transient probes, causing downstream cascading failures and noisy telemetry. This PR implements a Graceful Circuit Reset Orchestrator that centralizes 'reset' decisions per-region with three key features: sticky circuit memory to avoid rapid reopen/close loops, staggered reopen windows with exponential probe ramping, and cross-region priming probes to validate path health before allowing traffic. The orchestrator is conservative by default and can be tuned via config/feature flags. Changes include runtime controller logic, control plane API endpoints for orchestration, a light-weight in-memory sticky store with optional Redis backing, new telemetry events and dashboards, and integration tests. Rollout plan: feature flag enabled in control plane, default off for all regions, staged enable for canary region then global. Rollback plan: feature flag off => orchestrator bypassed; also includes a health-check bypass header to force legacy behavior for emergency remediation. Related: ENG-1984 SRE-204. Checklist: - [x] design doc reviewed by SRE and runtime - [x] unit and integration tests added - [x] telemetry events and Grafana dashboard queries included - [x] feature flag gating and runtime config validated - [x] rollout and rollback instructions in release_notes

release_notes: Add Graceful Circuit Reset Orchestrator: conservative orchestrator to coordinate circuit reopen across regions with sticky memory, staggered reopen windows, and priming probes. Feature-flagged. Improves stability during partial outages and reduces circuit flip noise. Rollout: enable in canary region, monitor 'circuit_reset_overview' dashboard, then enable globally. If regressions are observed, disable feature flag or use emergency bypass header.
upgrade_instructions: Deploy control plane changes first and enable orchestrator feature flag=false. Then deploy runtime with orchestrator available. Flip feature flag to true for canary region, monitor for 24h, then gradual rollouts. Redis backend optional; default in-memory sticky store used if not configured.
notes_for_oncall: If you see unexpected mass reopen events, check orchestrator logs (component=orchestrator) which include reason tags and reset_source. To force revert to legacy behavior set header 'X-Bypass-Orchestrator: true' on the control-plane config or disable feature flag immediately. Telemetry alerts: SRE-204 dashboard panels created for detection of reopen flapping.
